newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower as most blue chip issues lost amid profit-taking by small investors, brokers said.

Brokers said the share prices fell because of a limited market correction following three days of rally. "The market was very active as the prices were attractive to the buyers also because of the market correction," said one broker.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 14.42 points or 1.17 percent to 1,213.88 on a turnover of 83.2 million taka. Losers led gainers by 94 to 35. Bangladesh Lamps fell 146.26 taka to 5,039.92 and Beximco Pharma lost 3.19 to 169.36.
